dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 18, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Monday's Action Packed with Power Hitters and Dominant Pitchers**

Monday's slate of games saw several standout performances, with several players making their mark on the scoreboard. José Ramírez led the way with a 3-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance to help the Cleveland Guardians cruise to an 8-2 win over the Detroit Tigers.

In other action, Junior Caminero hit a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI game to propel the Tampa Bay Rays to a 16-6 victory over the Baltimore Orioles. Meanwhile, Justin Foscue went 3-for-3 with 1 home run and 3 RBIs to help the Colorado Rockies edge the Texas Rangers 7-6.

On the mound, Max Meyer tossed 6 shutout innings with 6 strikeouts to lead the Miami Marlins to a 12-0 thrashing of the Atlanta Braves. Jake Irvin allowed just 1 earned run over 4 innings with 6 strikeouts to help the New York Mets defeat the Washington Nationals 16-7.

In a surprise finish, the Milwaukee Brewers came from behind to defeat the Chicago Cubs 9-3, with Jake Bauers hitting a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI game. The Houston Astros and Minnesota Twins also went head-to-head, with Josh Bell hitting 2 home runs and driving in 4 runs to lead the Twins to a 6-3 victory.

Finally, Michael King threw 7 shutout innings with 9 strikeouts to lead the San Diego Padres to a 1-0 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers.
